title: Get the message event sets for ad creation
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain the message event sets that can be used to create [TikTok Instant Messaging Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482999036930). ## Before you start Ensure that you have message event sets within your ad account. If you don't have message event sets within your ad account, create message event sets [on TikTok Events Manager](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/how-to-create-message-events-on-tiktok-events-manager?lang=en). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ctm/message_event_set/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | messaging_app_type {Required} | string | The type of instant messaging app.

Enum values:
  • `MESSENGER`: Messenger.
  • `WHATSAPP`: WhatsApp.
  • `ZALO`: Zalo.
| | messaging_app_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the instant messaging app account.

  • If `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER`, specify a Facebook Page ID. A valid Facebook Page ID contains numbers only.
    • To find your Facebook Page ID, go to your Facebook Page and click About below your cover photo, then click Page transparency.
  • If `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP`, specify your WhatsApp phone number following the format: region calling code followed by phone number without any special symbols. For instance, if the region calling code is +1, and the phone number is (555) 555-1234, set this field to `15555551234`.
  • If `messaging_app_type` is `ZALO`, specify the Zalo Official Account ID.
| | message_event_name | string | The name of the message event set to filter the results by.

Exact match is supported. | | message_event_set_ids | string[] | The ID list of the message event sets to filter the results by.

Max size: 10. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ctm/message_event_set/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&messaging_app_type=WHATSAPP&messaging_app_account_id={{essaging_app_account_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| message_event_set_list | object[] | The list of existing message event sets within the specified ad account. | ##| message_event_set_id | string | The ID of the message event set. | ##| message_event_name | string | The name of the message event set. | ##| create_time | string | The time when the message event set was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:01`. | #| matched_event_set | object | The information about the only message event set that is associated with the instant messaging app account (`messaging_app_account_id`). | ##| message_event_set_id | string | The ID of the message event set. | ##| message_event_name | string | The name of the message event set. | ##| create_time | string | The time when the message event set was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:01`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "message_event_set_list": [ { "message_event_set_id": "{{message_event_set_id}}", "create_time": "2024-04-18 14:25:28", "message_event_name": "{{message_event_name}}" }, { "message_event_set_id": "{{message_event_set_id}}", "create_time": "2024-10-25 09:42:04", "message_event_name": "{{message_event_name}}" } ], "matched_event_set": { "message_event_set_id": "{{message_event_set_id}}", "create_time": "2024-10-25 09:42:04", "message_event_name": "{{message_event_name}}" } } } (/code) ```
